text:
Devon R.: quick async standup — what I did: rolled out router-proxy v2 to eu-west canary (3 nodes), observed minor 5xx spike on long-poll endpoints, mitigated by turning off request coalescing for that route.
Aj Patel: saw the spike on dashboards, curious — did you change batching config or kernel params?
Devon R.: only routing + a small tweak to max-concurrent-requests. suspect race around streaming handoff. logs show `stream_dispatch: dropped-conn` around same time.
Maria T.: thanks for the heads-up. oncall: have we paged anyone? need to avoid noisy paging if it's transient.
Devon R.: no page yet — I opened a short-lived alert in staging so we can simulate. real prod alert stayed within SLOs but error rate went from 0.05% to 0.9% for ~3m.
Liam S.: FYI, last night's autoscaler change could increase concurrent handoffs during canary rollouts. I will revert the cooldown tweak in 10m if we see more blips.
sre-bot: alert summary: #prod-longpoll ERR_RATE breach (0.9%) for 180s, top-trace: stream_dispatch->proto_negotiation.
Aj Patel: can you paste the exact commands you used for the canary? want to reproduce locally.
Devon R.: sure:```bash
# canary deploy
redwoodctl rollout set router-proxy:v2 --nodes eu-west-1-03,eu-west-1-07,eu-west-1-09 --traffic 8%```
Devon R.: and I toggled `--coalesce-requests=false` on that route via console.
Maria T.: two asks: 1) add a one-liner to the runbook about `coalesce` toggle and when to use it, 2) if this repeats, we should auto-fallback to router-proxy:v1 after 2min error spike.
Liam S.: agree on fallback. I'll add a canary policy that auto-rolls back if ERR_RATE > 0.5% for 120s.
Aj Patel: I grabbed a short trace. attaching snippet:```json
{"trace_id":"abc123","spans":["stream_dispatch","proto_negotiation","read_loop"]}```
Devon R.: nice catch. will instrument an extra metric around `handshake_latency` and push a tiny hotfix.
Maria T.: no blockers from my side. If you push hotfix, ping me so I can adjust alert debounce to avoid duplicate pages. :thumbsup:
Devon R.: plan for today: push fix behind a feature flag to 10% in eu-west, monitor 15m, then promote. I'll update the runbook and add a note in the incident section.
Liam S.: I'll queue the rollback policy PR and add unit tests for the canary-gating logic.
Aj Patel: I'll review traces and check synthetic checks for long-poll route.
Devon R.: thanks team. leaving a short checklist in Confluence and will follow up in ~30m. :eyes:
